description:
Connect your Metadata account to create editable, on-brand ad concepts, look up audience targeting criteria and estimate reach, inspect campaign setup, and analyze advertising performance and pipeline attribution. Work with campaign workflows for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Google Ads, and Microsoft Advertising, subject to your connected accounts, permissions, and the available tools. Review proposed changes before authorizing campaign launches or changes to live budgets.

An existing Metadata account with MCP access is required.

defaultPrompt: Compare the last 30 complete days of advertising with the prior 30 days. Explain changes and recommend three improvements.
Help me plan a LinkedIn audience of US software marketing leaders. Show the criteria and estimated reach before saving anything.
Create an editable LinkedIn ad concept using my brand kit and campaign brief. Preview it before saving or publishing.
